fieldData.excerpt: Token Holder Consultation on the proposed repurposing of the 2.4 billion XRD Stablecoin Reserve is now live. The consultation runs from 12:00 UTC on May 9th until 23:59 UTC on May 19th, 2025.
fieldData.main-content:
The Radix Foundation has opened the Token Holder Consultation on the proposed repurposing of the 2.4 billion XRD Stablecoin Reserve. The consultation runs from 12:00 UTC on May 9th until 23:59 UTC on May 19th, 2025.

This is your opportunity to input into the long-term direction of the Radix ecosystem.

What’s being proposed:

  • Allocate 1 billion XRD to a multi-season incentives campaign to grow on-chain activity and liquidity
  • Create a 1 billion XRD Growth Fund for strategic initiatives like T1 listings, bridges, etc.
  • Shorten the emission schedule by 20 years, reducing the max XRD supply by approximately 6 billion 
  • Hold 400 million XRD in reserve for future use or burn

How to participate:

Go to consultation.radixdlt.com and signal your support or opposition using your Radix Wallet. 

No transaction is required - signaling uses ROLA proofs, a secure off-ledger method that’s gas-free, privacy-preserving, and verifiable.

Signals are weighted based on the average XRD (or equivalent) held in your account(s) during the consultation window. Foundation-owned and high-concentration entities (>1B XRD) are excluded to ensure the outcome reflects the broader community.

Further details on the incentive campaign can be found here.

More details on the consultation process can be found here.
